item.title: Joe Gollner: a multi-layered definition of the "content" concept
item.description: Joe Gollner has worked with content from its earliest days and has crafted a multi-layered definition to account for is many aspects.

item.title: Alan J. Porter: storytelling for enterprise content strategy

item.title: Rob Punselie: content jobs to be done for customer experience
item.description: Rob Punselie uses content research methods based on time-tested usability knowledge and Jobs to Be Done to create better customer experiences.

item.title: Leah Buley and Joe Natoli: The UX Team of One, second edition
item.description: Leah Buley and Joe Natoli wrote "The UX Team of One" to share solo UX practice methods, balancing human-centered research and business value.

item.title: Sarah Johnson: moving content forward with Content-first Design
item.description: Sarah Johnson wrote "Content-first Design" to set out a content-first approach to design and to advocate or content practice.

item.title: Greg Dunlap: Designing Content Authoring Experiences
item.description: In Designing Content Authoring Experiences, Greg Dunlap shows content-system creators how to improve content authoring work.

item.title: Jeffrey A. "jam" McGuire: the value map content framework
item.description: Jeffrey A. "jam" McGuire is a content marketing expert and the creator of the value map framework.

item.title: Manny Silva: Docs as Tests for resilient technical documentation
item.description: Manny Silva is the author of the book "Docs as Tests: A Strategy for Resilient Technical Documentation" and a tech writer at Skyflow.

item.description: Melanie Seibert is a 25-year content design and management veteran and the author of the book "Managing Content Design Teams."
